actions.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.c_uxfmdw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE o.c_uxfmdw * o.c_erihes END - COALESCE(SUM(r.c_huwhnj), 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS average_net_order_value FROM r_jtcsax o LEFT JOIN r_kcqqae r ON o.c_skqytn = r.c_iizicc JOIN (SELECT c_xnmqkn, c_wyscvm FROM r_xvkhmu WHERE c_kkqbbk = (SELECT MAX(c_kkqbbk) FROM r_xvkhmu x WHERE x.c_xnmqkn = r_xvkhmu.c_xnmqkn)) cp ON o.c_perayc = cp.c_xnmqkn WHERE cp.c_wyscvm = 'North'

SELECT AVG(net_value) AS average_net_order_value FROM (SELECT o.c_skqytn, SUM(CASE WHEN o.c_uxfmdw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE o.c_uxfmdw * o.c_erihes END - COALESCE(SUM(r.c_huwhnj), 0)) AS net_value FROM r_jtcsax o LEFT JOIN r_kcqqae r ON o.c_skqytn = r.c_iizicc JOIN (SELECT c_xnmqkn, c_wyscvm FROM r_xvkhmu WHERE c_kkqbbk = (SELECT MAX(c_kkqbbk) FROM r_xvkhmu x WHERE x.c_xnmqkn = r_xvkhmu.c_xnmqkn)) cp ON o.c_perayc = cp.c_xnmqkn WHERE cp.c_wyscvm = 'North' GROUP BY o.c_skqytn) subquery

WITH customer_profiles AS (SELECT c_xnmqkn, c_wyscvm FROM r_xvkhmu WHERE c_kkqbbk = (SELECT MAX(c_kkqbbk) FROM r_xvkhmu x WHERE x.c_xnmqkn = r_xvkhmu.c_xnmqkn)), order_values AS (SELECT o.c_skqytn, SUM(CASE WHEN o.c_uxfmdw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE o.c_uxfmdw * o.c_erihes END) AS gross_value FROM r_jtcsax o GROUP BY o.c_skqytn), refund_values AS (SELECT r.c_iizicc, SUM(r.c_huwhnj) AS total_refunds FROM r_kcqqae r GROUP BY r.c_iizicc) SELECT CAST(AVG(COALESCE(ov.gross_value, 0) - COALESCE(rv.total_refunds, 0)) AS REAL) / 100.0 AS average_net_order_value FROM r_jtcsax o JOIN customer_profiles cp ON o.c_perayc = cp.c_xnmqkn LEFT JOIN order_values ov ON o.c_skqytn = ov.c_skqytn LEFT JOIN refund_values rv ON o.c_skqytn = rv.c_iizicc WHERE cp.c_wyscvm = 'North'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.c_uxfmdw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE o.c_uxfmdw * o.c_erihes END - COALESCE(SUM(r.c_huwhnj), 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS average_net_order_value FROM r_jtcsax o LEFT JOIN r_kcqqae r ON o.c_skqytn = r.c_iizicc JOIN (SELECT c_xnmqkn, c_wyscvm FROM r_xvkhmu WHERE c_kkqbbk = (SELECT MAX(c_kkqbbk) FROM r_xvkhmu x WHERE x.c_xnmqkn = r_xvkhmu.c_xnmqkn)) cp ON o.c_perayc = cp.c_xnmqkn WHERE cp.c_wyscvm = 'North'

SELECT AVG(net_value) AS average_net_order_value FROM (SELECT o.c_skqytn, SUM(CASE WHEN o.c_uxfmdw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE o.c_uxfmdw * o.c_erihes END - COALESCE(SUM(r.c_huwhnj), 0)) AS net_value FROM r_jtcsax o LEFT JOIN r_kcqqae r ON o.c_skqytn = r.c_iizicc JOIN (SELECT c_xnmqkn, c_wyscvm FROM r_xvkhmu WHERE c_kkqbbk = (SELECT MAX(c_kkqbbk) FROM r_xvkhmu x WHERE x.c_xnmqkn = r_xvkhmu.c_xnmqkn)) cp ON o.c_perayc = cp.c_xnmqkn WHERE cp.c_wyscvm = 'North' GROUP BY o.c_skqytn) subquery

WITH customer_profiles AS (SELECT c_xnmqkn, c_wyscvm FROM r_xvkhmu WHERE c_kkqbbk = (SELECT MAX(c_kkqbbk) FROM r_xvkhmu x WHERE x.c_xnmqkn = r_xvkhmu.c_xnmqkn)), order_values AS (SELECT o.c_skqytn, SUM(CASE WHEN o.c_uxfmdw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE o.c_uxfmdw * o.c_erihes END) AS gross_value FROM r_jtcsax o GROUP BY o.c_skqytn), refund_values AS (SELECT r.c_iizicc, SUM(r.c_huwhnj) AS total_refunds FROM r_kcqqae r GROUP BY r.c_iizicc) SELECT CAST(AVG(COALESCE(ov.gross_value, 0) - COALESCE(rv.total_refunds, 0)) AS REAL) / 100.0 AS average_net_order_value FROM r_jtcsax o JOIN customer_profiles cp ON o.c_perayc = cp.c_xnmqkn LEFT JOIN order_values ov ON o.c_skqytn = ov.c_skqytn LEFT JOIN refund_values rv ON o.c_skqytn = rv.c_iizicc WHERE cp.c_wyscvm = 'North'
